pins.name: TRIG
pins.notes: A 10 µs HIGH pulse starts a measurement

pins.name: ECHO
pins.notes: Outputs 5 V: use a voltage divider (e.g. 1 kΩ + 2 kΩ) before the ESP32 pin

gotchas.text: ECHO outputs 5 V. On a 3.3 V board, put a voltage divider (for example 1 kΩ and 2 kΩ) between ECHO and the pin.

source.title: Cytron / ElecFreaks HC-SR04 user manual
source.section: Electric parameters: working voltage DC 5 V

gotchas.text: It needs 5 V on VCC. At 3.3 V most modules give no echo or wrong distances.

source.title: Cytron / ElecFreaks HC-SR04 user manual
source.section: Electric parameters: working voltage DC 5 V

gotchas.text: Leave at least 60 ms between measurements, or the echo of the last one is measured again.
